model.template_validation.orders.name: orders
model.template_validation.orders.description: One row per order, with order status and fulfillment timestamps.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: Timestamp when the order was created.

returned_at.name: returned_at
returned_at.description: Timestamp when the order was returned.

shipped_at.name: shipped_at
shipped_at.description: Timestamp when the order was shipped.

delivered_at.name: delivered_at
delivered_at.description: Timestamp when the order was delivered.

num_of_item.name: num_of_item
num_of_item.description: Number of items in the order.

model.template_validation.order_items.name: order_items
model.template_validation.order_items.description: One row per order line item, with its selling price and fulfillment status.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.description: Parent order identifier joining to orders.order_id.

inventory_item_id.name: inventory_item_id
inventory_item_id.description: Inventory unit identifier joining to inventory_items.id.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: Timestamp when the order item was created.

shipped_at.name: shipped_at
shipped_at.description: Timestamp when the order item was shipped.

delivered_at.name: delivered_at
delivered_at.description: Timestamp when the order item was delivered.

returned_at.name: returned_at
returned_at.description: Timestamp when the order item was returned.

sale_price.name: sale_price
sale_price.description: Selling price of this order item.

model.template_validation.users.name: users
model.template_validation.users.description: One row per synthetic user, with profile and acquisition attributes.

gender.name: gender
gender.description: Gender recorded on the user profile.

traffic_source.name: traffic_source
traffic_source.description: Recorded acquisition source for the user.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

user_geom.name: user_geom
user_geom.description: Geographic point for the user location.

model.template_validation.products.name: products
model.template_validation.products.description: One row per catalog product, including category, cost, and retail price.

distribution_center_id.name: distribution_center_id
distribution_center_id.description: Distribution center identifier joining to distribution_centers.id.

model.template_validation.inventory_item.name: inventory_items
model.template_validation.inventory_item.description: One row per physical inventory unit, with stocking and sale timestamps and recorded product attributes.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: Timestamp when the unit entered inventory.

sold_at.name: sold_at
sold_at.description: Timestamp when the unit was sold.

product_distribution_center_id.name: product_distribution_center_id
product_distribution_center_id.description: Distribution center identifier joining to distribution_centers.id.

model.template_validation.events.name: events
model.template_validation.events.description: One row per website event, with session sequencing and event-level traffic source.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.description: User identifier when available. Joins to users.id.

sequence_number.name: sequence_number
sequence_number.description: Position of the event within its session.

session_id.name: session_id
session_id.description: Session identifier shared by events in the same visit.

ip_address.name: ip_address
ip_address.description: Synthetic IP address recorded for the event.

state.name: state
state.description: State or region recorded for the event.

postal_code.name: postal_code
postal_code.description: Postal code recorded for the event.

traffic_source.name: traffic_source
traffic_source.description: Traffic source recorded for the event.

uri.name: uri
uri.description: URI of the page associated with the event.

model.template_validation.distribution_c.name: distribution_centers
model.template_validation.distribution_c.description: One row per distribution center, with its name and coordinates.

distribution_center_geom.name: distribution_center_geom
distribution_center_geom.description: Geographic point for the distribution center.
